SELECT

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ABUSE_REPORT_FILE ( ABR_SN, FL_SN, ABR_FL_SORT_NO, ABR_FL_REG_ID, ABR_FL_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{reportSn}, #{fileSn}, #{sortNo}, #{actorId}, #{actorId} )

INSERT INTO ABUSE_REPORT_TRADE ( ABR_SN, TRD_SN, ABR_TRD_PREV_STATUS_CD, ABR_TRD_REMAIN_SEC, ABR_TRD_STLM_HOLD_YN, ABR_TRD_CHAT_CLOSE_YN, ABR_TRD_REG_ID, ABR_TRD_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{reportSn}, #{tradeSn}, #{previousStatusCode}, #{remainingSeconds}, CASE WHEN #{settlementHoldApplied} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CASE WHEN #{chatClosed} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{actorId}, #{actorId} )
mapper.select: SELECT f.FL_SN AS fileSn, f.FL_ORG_NM AS originalName, f.FL_EXT AS extension, f.FL_SIZE_AMT AS sizeAmount, rf.ABR_FL_SORT_NO AS sortNo FROM ABUSE_REPORT_FILE rf JOIN FILES f ON f.FL_SN = rf.FL_SN WHERE rf.ABR_SN = #{reportSn} AND f.FL_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY rf.ABR_FL_SORT_NO, rf.ABR_FL_SN
SELECT ABR_SN FROM ABUSE_REPORT WHERE RSK_EVT_SN = #{riskEventSn} FOR UPDATE

SELECT ABR_SN AS reportSn, RSK_EVT_SN AS riskEventSn, RPRT_USR_SN AS reporterUserSn, RPTD_USR_SN AS reportedUserSn, ABR_TYPE_CD AS reportTypeCode, ABR_STATUS_CD AS statusCode, ABR_REF_TYPE_CD AS referenceTypeCode, ABR_REF_SN AS referenceSn, ABR_CN AS content, ABR_PROC_RSN_CN AS processReason, ABR_PROC_REQ_ID AS processRequestId, ABR_REG_ID AS registeredBy, ABR_UPDT_ID AS updatedBy FROM ABUSE_REPORT WHERE ABR_SN = #{reportSn} FOR UPDATE
